   <tr> 
      <td valign="top" align="left">
        <a href="http://www.enviro-weather.msu.edu"> <b class="arial1">Enviro-Weather </a>:</b>
        <b class="arial2">Integrating MAWN weather data with models for making pest and other management decisions.</b>
      </td>
   </tr>

   <tr>
     <td valign="top" align="left"><br><br></td>
   </tr>
         
   <tr>
      <td class="arial2" valign="top" align="left"><b>
         Activities of the MSU Agricultural Weather Office are made possible by support from 
            <a href="http://www.msue.msu.edu">MSU Extension</a>,
            <a href="https://www.canr.msu.edu/research/index">MSU AgBioResearch</a>,
            <a href="http://www.geo.msu.edu">MSU Department of Geography, Environment, and Spatial Sciences</a>, and the
            <a href="http://climate.geo.msu.edu">MSU Climatology Office</a>.</b>
      </td>
   </tr>
